**UI-for-ytdlp v0.3.0** adds GoodGame.ru VOD support, hardens the download pipeline, and improves utility updates.

#### GoodGame.ru VOD (pluggable)
- **VOD URLs** like `https://goodgame.ru/vods/{streamId}/{timestamp}` are resolved via the GoodGame API v4 and downloaded through yt-dlp as HLS → single MP4
- **Pluggable architecture:** handler lives in `core/plugins/goodgame_vod.py`; core downloader only uses `resolve_download_hints()`
- **Easy disable:** set `ENABLE_GOODGAME_VOD_HANDLER: false` in `utilities/config.json`, or remove the handler from `PLUGIN_REGISTRY` when yt-dlp adds native support
- Clipboard and URL validation recognize GoodGame VOD links when the plugin is enabled

#### Download pipeline and utilities
- **ffmpeg updater:** zip integrity check, safe `Content-Length` parsing, re-download on corrupt archives, user-visible warning on failure
- **Progress callbacks:** fixed Python closure bugs in utility-update lambdas (stale progress text)
- **Pipeline tests** and **AGENTS.md** for contributors

#### Quality
- **230+ unit tests** in CI; core coverage threshold unchanged (70%)
